MNG 162 Beaded Rosette for Cabinet Handles

text.description_html:
MNG 162, 1.5 Inch Diameter Hobnail Cabinet Knob Rosette

The Hobnail Cabinet Knob Backplate can be added to cabinet knobs to make them even more dramatic and decorative. The 1.5 Inch Diameter Hobnail Cabinet Knob Rosette will look amazing paired with any matching Cabinet Knob. If using with a pull, you will need two rosettes per pull, one for each mount.

This cabinet knob is part of the MNG Vanilla Collection.

Specifications and Features of the MNG 16213 Beaded Rosette for Cabinet Handles:

  • Base Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1/8"

    • Sold Individually
